name: wavex
description: Get your own WaveX automations page in your claude.ai account (/wavex:wavex-shop), with an optional helper so it can list your Claude Code sessions in the Claude desktop app. Post a repeatable job from your Claude Code session to the WaveX marketplace: draft, scrub, price, confirm, submit for review (/wavex:wavex-post), or save the session privately (/wavex:wavex-post --save). Uses your claude.ai connector named wavex; the plugin adds no server to Claude Code.
